## Approach

What design or analysis are you proposing, and why? How does it differ from
the lead Design #2? Link to your directory under `designs/`.

## Reproduce the work

Give the command and link to the README describing inputs, dependencies and
tool/model versions. Identify any additional downloads by location and checksum.

## Results

Link to the antigen table, predictions, sequence files or other outputs you
produced. Identify unspecified components and unfinished work. Explain which
results reuse predictions, run new inference or come from experiments.

## Shared-code or evidence changes

If applicable, explain the problem, the change and how you checked it.

See [the contribution guide](https://github.com/popvax/yash/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.
